name: Galaxy Medical Alert Systems
notes: Researched from Galaxy Medical Alert Systems' public home, My Account (sign-in/register form only; never signed in), FAQs, Terms & Conditions, Shipping & Returns Policy and product pages. Galaxy is based in Windsor, Ontario and all prices are in Canadian dollars (the engine shows plain $). My Account: 'Username or email address', Password, 'Remember me', 'Log in', 'Lost your password?'; Register asks for Username and Email address and emails a link to set the password. Terms: private-pay customers are charged recurring charges on the card on file, or by automatic draft from the bank account on file (AutoPay, bank+card); subscriber information changes (phones, address, responders) are made by calling 1-855-905-7414. Returns/cancellation: call customer care 1-866-945-5027 (Mon-Fri 9-5 ET) for a return authorization number, ship in original packaging with tracking to 361 Joffre Place, Windsor, ON N8X 2T1; unreturned or damaged equipment is charged at published rates. FAQ/site: no long-term contract, no activation fee, two months free on annual plans, lifetime price guarantee. Plans are the product pages' 'From' monthly prices: Home Cellular System $34.95, Home Cellular System with Fall Detection $44.95, Mobile System with GPS & Fall Detection $49.95 (current plan is a simulation choice; plan changes online not documented). No public page describes paying an invoice online in My Account; pay_online inferred from the account area. Payment plans phone-only (inferred); scheduled/paperless unknown. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): added the Terms' three-month auto-renewing agreement (30 days' written notice), 90-day prepaid refund window and 30-days-past-due suspension (help 'service-agreement'). The FAQ's 'no long-term contract' banner is kept; a three-month term is consistent with it.

help.title: Pricing and billing FAQ
paragraphs: All Galaxy prices are in Canadian dollars. Monitoring starts at $34.95 a month for the Home Cellular System, $44.95 with fall detection and $49.95 for the mobile GPS and watch systems, with free shipping, a free lock box and free equipment.
Annual plans get two months of service free. There is no long-term contract and no activation fee, and Galaxy offers a lifetime price guarantee.
If you are ordering for someone else, such as a parent, Galaxy can bill your credit card for their service. You can order online or by phone at 1-855-905-7414.

help.title: Recurring payments
paragraphs: Private-pay customers are billed automatically: if you gave Galaxy a credit card, recurring charges are made to that card, and if you gave bank account details, payments are drafted from that account.
If an agency or government program pays for your service, the subscriber is not billed for the approved services.

help.title: Cancel service and return equipment
paragraphs: To cancel or return equipment, first call customer care at 1-866-945-5027 (Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET) to get a return authorization number.

Send everything back in good working order in the original packaging with the authorization number clearly marked, using a carrier with tracking, to 361 Joffre Place, Windsor, ON N8X 2T1, Canada. The equipment stays Galaxy's property; if it is not returned or arrives damaged, you are charged its replacement or repair cost.

help.title: Update your information
paragraphs: To update subscriber details such as phone numbers, your address or your responders, call Galaxy toll free at 1-855-905-7414. Keep health information current so responders get accurate details.

help.title: Your service agreement
paragraphs: Your Galaxy agreement runs for three months at a time and renews automatically unless you or Galaxy give written notice at least 30 days before the term ends.

When the agreement ends, prepaid fees can be refunded for up to 90 days, provided all Galaxy equipment has been returned; charges for damaged or unreturned equipment may be deducted. An account more than 30 days past due can have service suspended and the agreement ended after five days' written notice.
